did: Ran the Nov 19 choir through the night while the owner slept: merged fifteen PRs across some-ui and home's server one at a time, each reviewed and checked against main. Rust Rounds gained a recording per speak-to point, an essay that judges each point, the new week format of decisions with an academy, home keeping tracked work time, and the essay's fork scene; the interview essay opens in the owner's voice and lists past weeks; every tappable card on the phone now looks like one. I found and had fixed an overlap in tracked work spans before it merged, fixed home's count of a new-format week's points myself, deployed the Jobs mailbox, wound down six workers with their notes, and wrote where each story stands on its epic.

calls.title: Refuse a tracked work span that starts before the last one closed
options: Document that the phone must not replay a refused start
calls.why: Spans could overlap and count the same hour twice when a phone came back online; refusing narrows what home accepts without changing the story.
calls.undo: Drop the Overlaps check in rust_round work_span start.

calls.title: Count a new-format ticket's points from its forks
options: Forks for a /2 week, speakTo for /1
calls.why: A /2 ticket has no speakTo, so every per-point take of a new-format week would have been refused.

left: Home runs the new week format and work spans only after the next make home-deploy; the routine keeps writing the old format until then.
The Residual Ledger lines for five epics wait for the owner's word, as asked.
Five stale handoff branches need deleting by hand: the git proxy drops branch deletes.
